description: Defines the BufferHubBase class, a base class for BufferHub clients (ProducerBuffer and ConsumerBuffer), including methods for buffer management, synchronization, and metadata handling within the android::dvr namespace.

classes.name: BufferHubBase
classes.description: Base class for BufferHub clients managing shared buffers, synchronization, and metadata.

methods.name: CreateConsumer
methods.description: Creates a new consumer channel attached to the producer, returning a file descriptor or error.

methods.name: GetBlobReadWritePointer
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to a blob buffer of specified size, handling locking internally.

methods.name: GetBlobFd
methods.description: Returns a duplicated file descriptor for shared memory access to the blob.

methods.name: GetEventMask
methods.description: Gets event mask for the client channel.

methods.name: GetEventSources
methods.description: Retrieves event sources for the client channel.

methods.name: native_handle
methods.description: Returns the native handle associated with the buffer.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Accessors for the IonBuffer object.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the buffer's global ID.

methods.name: cid
methods.description: Returns the client’s channel ID.

methods.name: buffer_state
methods.description: Returns the current buffer state.

methods.name: is_released
methods.description: Checks if the buffer has been released by all clients.

methods.name: client_state_mask
methods.description: Returns the client-specific state mask.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Returns the stride of the buffer.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the format of the buffer.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Returns the usage flags of the buffer.

methods.name: layer_count
methods.description: Returns the layer count of the buffer.

methods.name: GetQueueIndex
methods.description: Gets the queue index from metadata.

methods.name: SetQueueIndex
methods.description: Sets the queue index in metadata.

methods.name: ImportBuffer
methods.description: Helper for buffer import initialization.

methods.name: CheckMetadata
methods.description: Validates metadata operation.

methods.name: UpdateSharedFence
methods.description: Updates shared fence handles.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a specified area of the buffer for usage.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.
